fields.weather: Clear, 29°F at the Larkin airport. Light northwest wind, no precipitation.
fields.load: Normal Tuesday: Prairie Gold's Larkin feed mill and Dunmore processing plant (410 employees) on regular schedules
fields.staffing: EOC not activated; Sheriff's day shift has six deputies on patrol; Highway crews on routine fall maintenance
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 07:50 on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, a cold, clear fall morning in Calder County: 29°F at the Larkin airport, light northwest wind and no precipitation. The fall waterfowl migration is at its peak, and residents have been posting photos of big flocks of geese and ducks on the sloughs north of Larkin. The county EOC in the Public Safety Building Training Room is dark, there are no active incidents, and on Monday cooperative veterinarian Dr. Anders Whitfield sampled a flock after two days of rising deaths and falling water use. Nobody in this room has heard the result yet.
